newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam fuel bunkers dip, demand tails off.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam fuel bunkers dip, demand tails off.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers dipped by $1 a tonne on Friday and demand tailed off ahead of a three-day weekend in much of Europe

Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at $85.50/$86 fob, about $1 a tonne lower than on Thursday. Prices came off in the barge market partly as two players led the initial selling. Some traders said they were interested in setting lower numbers.

Total ARA bunker volumes were fairly small after healthy business on Thursday. "It's really been pretty quiet today. There has been some covering, but it was almost all done yesterday," a supplier said.
Hamburg was busier, which explained the $1 rise in prices. Dealers added that one physical supplier was running short of product.
Mediterranean bunkers were steady to slightly firmer, the strength more in eastern areas.
